Hi everyone,
Thank you for enjoying Fight Crab 2.
Today, we have updated to Ver. 0.8.01.2.

Ver. 0.8.01.2
Feature Changes

Your crab will now react and punch immediately if you tell it to punch while holding the throw button.
Weapon energy is no longer spent during the opening sequence of battles.
Cards are no longer canceled when you get on or off a crab.
Adjusted the damage dealt by weapons to opponent pincers so that weapons with high Sharpness can also deal damage.
In online play, players with a framerate below 30fps will take more damage, and the knockdown counter will count down in real time.
It is now easier to break out of a downed state by standing back upright.

Added a visual indicator of the effect area of Fire Claw.
Adjusted the lighting in Crab-Trap Dungeon.

Balancing

Gada:
The longer the chain is extended, the more difficult it is to stagger the opponent, and the higher the stamina cost.
Rocket:
It will now continue to fly until it explodes once ignited.
Improved the stability of the following crabs:
Elbow crab, Hanasaki crab, king crab, Calappa, carrier crab, red frog crab, Dungeness crab
Lowered the durability of the tanks in the desert stage.
